properties.description: The two steps main() runs FIRST, once, for every one-shot mode (--call, --export, --export-snapshot, --import, --diff, --merge, --merge-apply, --merge-driver, --stop-shared, setup), before anything can open a store. `gate` applies the table (Mode::honours): every flag given on the command line that the mode does not read is refused by name with the mode, exit 1; two modes are refused together; environment and default values are left alone. `resolve_design` answers "where is this design?" without opening anything: a folder whose .reflow2.toml names a design on a server is refused with its id and address; --read-only refuses a write and creates nothing; --only-if-present keeps its session meaning; and a READ (the mode, or the --call tool's served read_only_hint) never creates a design — except in a folder that opted in (.reflow2/ present and empty).
properties.name: one_shot.rs — every one-shot mode resolves its design first, and the flag × mode table
